reception_dependency: Sheet 01 desk and staff chair GLBs instantiated unchanged; source .blend embeds editable instances. Do not count these as new reception assets.
clearances: Main entry clear 1.5m. Planter and waiting furniture placed outside central circulation. Placement recommendations only; not a building/accessibility certification.
rig_status: 1.65m fit assumptions, unverified in target game. No runtime behavior.

layout_coordinate_contract.authoritative_layout: room_layouts[].instances uses room-local glTF axes. Load asset_uri and apply the supplied position, quaternion and unit scale to a new parent instance root. Do not add the Blender display origin.
layout_coordinate_contract.blender_to_gltf: (x,y,z) -> (x,z,-y); positive Blender Z yaw becomes positive glTF Y yaw. Quaternion order is x,y,z,w.
layout_coordinate_contract.room_origin: floor surface at room center; each tier is independent at [0,0,0].
layout_coordinate_contract.display_offsets: The editable .blend displays tiers side-by-side at Blender X = -7, 0, +7 m. These offsets are presentation only and have been removed from room-local placements.
layout_coordinate_contract.asset_uri_base: URI paths resolve relative to the extracted 12_lobby/manifest.json directory. Extract 01_reception_Runtime.zip and 12_lobby_Runtime.zip into the same parent directory, leaving their top-level 01_reception/ and 12_lobby/ folders intact.
layout_coordinate_contract.source_bundle_note: Source .blend already contains editable asset instances. Source ZIP paths include runtime subfolders; the URI mapping targets the extracted Runtime ZIP layout, not the Source ZIP layout.

runtime_dependencies.reuse: Exact sheet 01 GLBs, loaded as instances; no separate reception geometry build.
